body.objective: Replace only the original cross-run full-graph comparison requirement with evidence supported by the unchanged diagnostic driver and existing regressions.

prohibited_actions: Modify the frozen diagnostic driver or add graph-comparison tooling.
Relax existing regression assertions or live integrity checks.
Claim literal full-graph bijection from summary hashes.

body.replacement: Compare the two unchanged-driver runs' numeric step_index and ledger_revision, lifecycle call counts and same_state_as_predecessor relation. Preserve actual hashes as provenance, without treating matching or differing hashes alone as proof of cross-run graph equivalence. Require the original affected first-parent regression assertions and live source/effect/transition integrity checks to pass on the candidate. Separately require exact canonical payload-byte and hash equality on the fixed original-versus-candidate microbenchmark corpus.
acceptance_criteria: Comparable driver fields and expected lifecycle counts agree.
Original affected first-parent regressions and live integrity checks pass without weakened assertions.
Microbenchmark canonical payload bytes and hashes match exactly.
Report this combined assurance accurately; do not claim literal cross-run full-graph bijection.
required_tests: The original directive's bounded before/after runs, focused and affected regressions remain unchanged; this amendment adds no execution.
constraints: Preserve the original directive and all historical artifacts.
Only the identified semantic-comparison clause is replaced. All other scope, measurement, safety and review requirements remain active.
This is Design guidance, not implementation approval or REVIEW PASS.
